issues: Checker verdict KNOWN upheld. I re-fetched DLMF 10.32.1, 10.35.2, 10.25.2 and 10.40.1 and all say what the checker claims. I re-derived the z>=1 Laplace bound I_0(z) >= e^{z-1/2}/(pi sqrt z) and checked it numerically: the ratio is 2.41 at z=1 and tends to 2.066. I also checked the psi <= a_s ln(1+z^r) combination with a_s = 3+s/2 and r = 1/s, which uses r<=1 and s*r=1. Minor bib fix: the official DLMF citation (dlmf.nist.gov/help/cite) includes 'Release 1.2.8 of 2026-09-15' in howpublished, and the checker's entry omits it. Caveat: DLMF 10.40(iii) gives rigorous remainder bounds only for K_nu, not I_nu, so the paper should not lean on DLMF for a rigorous I_0 lower bound; its own two-line proof is correct. No prior source was found that states the specific psi bound, and it is ad hoc and needs none. Sharper literature bounds (Baricz, Laforgia-Natalini) could not be fetched: Springer paywall, arXiv API HTTP 429, and the WebSearch session budget was exhausted at 200/200. So no extra citation is added. Infra: the search-budget exhaustion and the arXiv 429s probably contribute to the slow verify stage.

extra_citations.why: Corrected form of the checker's DLMF entry, with the release number required by DLMF's own citation guidance. Cite Eq. 10.32.1 (integral rep.), 10.35.2 (Jacobi-Anger) plus 10.25.2 (I_k >= 0), and optionally 10.40.1 (sharp constant 1/sqrt(2 pi)).
